name: Rotation
description: Ehsan loves geometry! Especially he likes to rotate points! Given a point in the plane, Ehsan likes to rotate it by k degrees (counter-clockwise), around the origin . What is the result of this rotation?
input_specification: A single integer k ( 0 ≤ k < 360 ) is given in the first line. Two integer numbers x and y are given in the second line ( - 1390 ≤ x , y ≤ 1390 ).
output_specification: Write two numbers. The result of the rotation. Your answer must have a relative error less than 10 - 1 .
subsubtopic: 480. Points, Vectors, Transformations, Dot Products, Cross Products, Precision Issues and Polar Sort(2D)
approach_summary: Apply Points, Vectors, Transformations, Dot Products, Cross Products, Precision Issues and Polar Sort(2D) paradigm under the Geometry framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
